QuestInfo.name: Bedin's Visitor
QuestInfo.0: Find #bBedin#k, the Zenumist alchemist. Use the stairs inside the Zenumist Society to get to #b#m261010000##k.
QuestInfo.1: Bedin was being tight-lipped, but offered to refresh his memory if you got him #b50#k #b#t4000351##k items. #b#t4000351##k can be acquired from\r\n#b#o2110301##k creatures in #b#m260020500##k.
QuestInfo.2: You brought the #t4000351# samples to Bedin and he told you his story. He claims a #bsmall girl with pigtails#k asked about a medicine that could find hidden truths. She was in need of alchemy to #bsave the life of her brother#k. Bedin told the girl to speak with #bRussellon#k of the Alcadno, in #b#m261020000##k.

0.0: W-What do you want? You know this place isn't open to the public, right?\r\n#L0##bCarson gave his permission.#l\n#k
0.1: I-I see. What brings you here?\r\n#L0##bI want to know more about the strange person who asked you about creating life with alchemy.#l\n#k
0.2: That was... I don't really remember, you know? It's been a few months. Maybe if you help me get a good #b#t4000351##k shipment?

yes.0: Can you bring #b50#k #b#t4000351##k samples? I'll try to remember while you do that. The #b#o2110301##k that wander around #b#m260020500##k should carry them.

no.0: I happened to need a lot of #b#t4000351##k samples for my experiment. I won't be able to concentrate if the experiments are hanging over my head, will I?

1.0: Did you bring the Scorpion Stings? They're helping me remember...\r\n#L0##bCan you describe the strange person that came to you?#l\n#k
1.1: No, I still don't remember anybody strange. The only person who came to see me was an #bordinary little girl#k.\r\n#L0##bThat's it? A little girl? Nobody else has been down here?#l\n#k
1.2: Not too many people come by for alchemy lessons. Given the secretive nature of the science, we usually keep it under wraps, but this girl's circumstances made it different...\r\n#L0##bWhat do you mean by that?#l\n#k
1.3:
Well, she said she was trying to #bsave her brother's life#k.
She wanted to know about magic that could hide things... I mean, I don't know how they're related, but how could I turn a sad girl down? 
#L0##bHer brother's life? You don't have any other details?#l
#k
1.4: I know it's forbidden to teach alchemy to ordinary citizens, but I couldn't just ignore her plea. I only gave her a #bhint#k though.\r\n#L0##bWhat kind?#l\n#k
1.5: I told her about a medicine that reveals hidden truths... Only, it'd take ME 100 years to make it. That's why I sent her over to #bRussellon#k in the Alcadno institute.

yes.0: Russellon is an Alcadno alchemist. He should be in #b#m261020000##k. Those Alcadno guys are creepy... especially him.

item.0: Did you bring #b50 #t4000351##k samples? I don't think my memories will return otherwise. Remember, the #b#o2110301##k monsters on #b#m260020500##k should have them.
